title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Bryant University
description: Verifiable late-night dining options for Bryant University students, including on-campus hubs and nearby local favorites in Smithfield and Lincoln.

cards.title: Ronzio Pizza
cards.subtitle: Newport House
cards.notes: Located on the ground floor of Newport House, this campus staple serves pizza and subs until 1 AM Sunday-Wednesday and 2 AM Thursday-Saturday.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus pizza and sub shop located in Newport House with late-night weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Ronzio at Bryant University is open until 1 AM Sun-Wed and 2 AM Thu-Sat during the semester.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1 AM Sun-Wed and 2 AM Thu-Sat during the academic semester.

cards.title: The Exchange
cards.subtitle: Fisher Student Center
cards.notes: Grab freshly crafted sandwiches, salads, and snacks at this Fisher Student Center hub, which stays open until 11 PM on weekdays.
cards.short_summary: A quick-service dining location in the Fisher Student Center offering late-night snacks and meals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Exchange is open until 11 PM Monday through Friday during the semester.
cards.source_title: The Exchange - Information Directory - Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 PM Monday-Friday during the semester.

cards.title: Tupper's
cards.subtitle: Fisher Student Center
cards.notes: Order Mexican fare from Agave or burgers from CRAFT via Grubhub at this student center spot, open until 11 PM daily.
cards.short_summary: A multi-concept dining venue in the Fisher Student Center featuring tacos and burgers.
cards.evidence_claim: Tupper's is open until 11 PM daily (Mon-Fri 11 AM-11 PM, Sat-Sun 5 PM-11 PM) during the semester.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 PM daily during the semester.

cards.title: Levine 24-Hour Vending
cards.subtitle: BELC Ground Floor
cards.notes: The only spot on campus for 24-hour 'Gourmet Fresh Food Vending,' offering restocked lunch and dinner options all night long.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour gourmet vending area in the Business Entrepreneurship Leadership Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Corey E. Levine '80 Dining Commons features a 24-hour vending area with fresh food options.
cards.source_title: Corey E. Levine '80 Dining Commons - Information Directory - Bryant University
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 for fresh food and snacks.

cards.title: Manville Palace Pizza
cards.subtitle: Railroad Street
cards.notes: A legendary off-campus delivery option for Bryant students, this Lincoln pizza shop is open until 3 AM every single day.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza shop in Lincoln known for late-night delivery and 3 AM closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Manville Palace Pizza is open until 3 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3 AM daily for delivery and takeout.

cards.title: IHOP
cards.subtitle: George Washington Highway
cards.notes: Located just a short drive from campus in Lincoln, this 24-hour diner is a go-to for pancakes and breakfast at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour breakfast chain restaurant located near the Bryant campus in Lincoln.
cards.evidence_claim: The IHOP in Lincoln on George Washington Highway is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: IHOP® Breakfast in Lincoln, RI on 622 George Washington Highway

cards.title: Applebee's Grill + Bar
cards.subtitle: Putnam Pike
cards.notes: A popular late-night destination in nearby Greenville, serving a full menu of appetizers and burgers until 1 AM daily.
cards.short_summary: A casual dining restaurant in Greenville open until 1 AM for late-night meals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Applebee's in Greenville (Smithfield) is open until 1 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Applebee's Grill + Bar Restaurant in Greenville, RI

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Dowling Village Blvd
cards.notes: Located in North Smithfield, this Taco Bell serves its full menu of tacos and burritos until 1 AM daily for late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food restaurant in North Smithfield with late-night drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 2 Dowling Village Blvd is open until 1 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in North Smithfield, RI

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: Putnam Pike
cards.notes: This Greenville location offers 24-hour drive-thru service, making it a reliable stop for late-night fries and burgers.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fast-food restaurant in Greenville with drive-thru access.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's on Putnam Pike in Greenville is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Greenville, RI at 445 Putnam Pike - McDonald's

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: Cedar Swamp Road
cards.notes: A standard delivery choice for the Bryant community, this Smithfield location delivers until midnight or later on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A pizza delivery chain in Smithfield serving the Bryant University area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Domino's on Cedar Swamp Road in Smithfield is open until 12 AM daily.
cards.source_title: 9 Cedar Swamp Road in Smithfield - Domino's Pizza
